name: Standard (3-player)
description: The default 3-player game (D63): the full Dragon rules of Good Practice, except the King moves one square in any direction, as in the 2-player Standard (decision 0016). Experimental until bot self-play shows the seats are balanced.
notes: Played before S68 built coast.3p.exit, so every Coast piece could leave the Coast with any legal move. Kept with a lock (any-legal-move) so its games and fairness reports replay as they were played (decision 0019).
